title: census.py finish drops the sweep's invalidation and relink lines when a later step fails
goal: census.py finish prints kbdecide.py sweep's invalidation and relink lines when a later step (index, commit) fails, so the report keeps them (a rerun prints invalidated=0)

run:
import argparse, collections, contextlib, io, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import census, kbcommon
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', d, 'init', '-q'], check=True)
log = os.path.join(d, 'log.csv'); open(log, 'w').write('id\n')
kbcommon.HOME = d
census.plan_finish = lambda root, log, date: [
    {'name': 'sweep', 'argv': ['python3', '-c', "print('invalid' + 'ated=1 D-0000' + '0000')"], 'ok': (0,), 'skip': '', 'capture': True},
    {'name': 'index', 'argv': ['python3', '-c', 'raise SystemExit(1)'], 'ok': (0,), 'skip': '', 'capture': False}]
out = io.StringIO()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(out):
    code = census.cmd_finish(argparse.Namespace(date='2026-10-21', log=log, dry_run=False), collections.Counter())
t = out.getvalue()
print('exit', code, 'sweep lines kept:', 'invalidated=1 D-00000000' in t)
sys.exit(0 if code != 0 and 'invalidated=1 D-00000000' in t else 1)
